title: Create and recover diagnostics across two editors
naturalLanguageTask: Create a syntax error in main.js and verify its red diagnostic underline, switch to renderer.js through the command palette and create a separate JSX syntax error there, verify both editors' errors independently, then return to each editor and restore its exact default fixture source until both introduced diagnostics disappear. Do not save.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog is open, and the unobstructed default main.js and renderer.js editors are visible

precondition: Lynxtron Fiddle shows the unmodified default main.js and renderer.js source; neither editor contains an ActOnce probe, regardless of any dependency or JSX diagnostics already present in the default renderer.js fixture

steps.target: inside the visible first line of the top-left main.js source editor at approximately display-local (720, 230), not renderer.js or preload.js

steps.prompt: The main.js editor now visibly contains exactly 'const actOnceMainProbe = @' instead of its default source
main.js visibly has a red wavy diagnostic underline on the illegal @ token in 'const actOnceMainProbe = @'
The command palette search contains renderer.js and its renderer.js result is selected
The renderer.js editor now visibly contains exactly the incomplete ActOnceProbe JSX source
renderer.js visibly has a red wavy diagnostic underline on the incomplete JSX source

steps.target: inside the visible first line of the top-left main.js source editor at approximately display-local (720, 230), not the center of the editor mosaic or the renderer.js pane

steps.prompt: main.js is restored to its default source, contains no ActOnce probe, and has no red diagnostic underline

steps.target: inside the visible first line of the top-right renderer.js source editor at approximately display-local (1260, 230), not the center of the editor mosaic or the main.js pane

steps.prompt: renderer.js is restored to the exact default Hello Lynxtron ReactLynx source and no longer contains the ActOnceProbe syntax error; ignore dependency-resolution or JSX diagnostics already present in the default fixture
